# Painted by Natalia

> A vibrant online gallery and community platform celebrating soft pastel landscape art, featuring Natalia's portfolio, painting techniques, and the Landscape Art Club—a global community of artists engaged in weekly creative challenges.

Painted by Natalia is the creative hub of Munich-based artist Natalia, showcasing her fine art in soft pastels alongside an active community platform. The site combines her professional portfolio with educational content, artist interviews, and the Landscape Art Club—a thriving community that hosts weekly and monthly painting challenges to inspire and connect landscape artists worldwide.

## Artist & Portfolio

- [Soft Pastel Landscape Art | Painted by Natalia – Fine Art & Inspiration](https://www.paintedbynatalia.com): Homepage showcasing Natalia's soft pastel landscape art and Landscape Art Club community
- [About Natalia - Artist and Visionary | Painted by Natalia](https://www.paintedbynatalia.com/about): Artist biography and creative journey of Natalia based in Munich with guild memberships
- [Portfolio | painted by natalia](https://www.paintedbynatalia.com/portfolio-2025): Solo exhibition portfolio featuring soft pastel landscapes, florals, and architectural art

## Landscape Art Club

- [Landscape Art Club: Weekly and Monthly Art Challenges, Art Community | painted by natalia](https://www.paintedbynatalia.com/landscapeartclub): Landscape Art Club community hub with weekly/monthly challenges and artist engagement
- [Landscape Art Club Weekly Challenge | Painted by Natalia](https://www.paintedbynatalia.com/landscapeartclub/weeklychallenge): Weekly challenge rules, participation guidelines, and submission instructions
- [Landscape Art Club Blog – Weekly Challenges & Tips | Painted by Natalia](https://www.paintedbynatalia.com/landscapeartclub-blog): Blog featuring weekly painting challenges with photo prompts and composition tips
- [Weekly Challenges (List) | painted by natalia](https://www.paintedbynatalia.com/weekly-challenges): Archive and library of all weekly challenge prompts with location-based categories
- [painted by natalia | Became a co-host of the weekly challenge](https://www.paintedbynatalia.com/landscapeartclub/become-a-co-host): Application page for becoming a co-host of Landscape Art Club weekly challenges
